Guard checks top owner and positive slots, not unequipped status. Direct-equipped state updates stats.

Calls getImbuements which retains the configurable storage filter; cannot assume advertised scroll quest exemption. Storage lookup itself is malformed.

getStorageValue receives result of (storage == -1), a boolean, rather than storage ID; rejection depends on unrelated storage 0 for ordinary positive IDs.

Iterates all slots after debit and clears each found state, updating equipped stats; no clear fee in this method.

engine_facts.notes: Actual code gives all three utilities same branch; not a Global proof of fine-grained timer behavior.
Per-tick inventory scan excludes nested container objects and combat timers in PZ/noncombat.
Three XML entries use unhandled effect type vibrancy. No fallback branch translates it; configured chance is ignored by parser. Description alone is not functionality.
Dormant for XML Vibrancy due to loader mismatch. Deflection checks have no attacker context; not proof of actual monster/PvP behavior on Global.

XML values are additive imbuement modifiers, separate from the intrinsic character baseline. Primary news8421 and revisioned post-release Fandom corroborate baseline5%/10% and additive Strike5%/5,15,40%. Combined isolated totals15,25,50% and chance10% are retained only as outcomes, never emitted as item modifiers. Other perks remain outside this comparison.
Checks and consumes inventory first, then stash; conflicts with owning architecture candidate first-slice backpack-only decision.
Money/materials are debited before onApplyImbuementOnScroll removes blank and inserts output. Insertion failure has no compensation here; no rollback proof.
Both datapacks add Imbuement Assistant selling complete recipe bundles for custom gold prices; normalized separately from Yana exchange and never admitted as Global wares.
Actual per-target source formula; order multiplies proportion before rounding and clamps result to actual health removed. N must be positive by caller invariant.
realDamage is min(targetHealth, primary+secondary), possibly adjusted further by prepare-death or target rules, then passed to both leech routines.

engine_facts.value: one damaging Combat::applyExtensions call before target iteration
engine_facts.notes: Damaging applyExtensions excludes healing; Blessing of the Grove has a separate healing critical path. uniform_random(1,100)*100 is compared to total critical chance in basis points. This is engine structure rather than verified Global RNG granularity.
Loop uses current residual damage and rounds each step; aggregate equivalent is not generally interchangeable once integer rounding applies. Other innate/reduction paths also exist.

engine_facts.value: independent integer assignment of physical residual and elemental share
engine_facts.notes: First applicable conversion is applied only when primary type is physical; writes each floating product into integer combat fields, truncating toward zero.

addItemImbuementStats passes each nonzero skill contribution to setVarSkill; per-player varSkills accumulates equipment effects before total leech amount is fetched. Source evidence only, not official composition proof.
Pinned branch permits critical spell/rune healing only in this wheel-specific path, on already-boosted healing. This is an OTS implementation hypothesis rather than live release proof.
Both leech routines are skipped when extension is set or damage origin is ORIGIN_CONDITION.
Endpoint-inclusive RNG and >= comparison are preserved explicitly; do not infer a uniform 100% server guarantee from XML alone.
getAllImbuementsIntricateAndPowerful accepts player but does not inspect it. This selection routine lacks these filters; other caller behavior is a separate question.
config.lua.dist disables shrine and per-type storage checks by default; malformed lookup remains a defect when enabled.

selected_catalogue_comparison.effect_normalization: Strike XML is an additive imbuement modifier: chance500bps and extra damage500/1500/4000bps. Intrinsic character baseline500bps chance/1000bps extra is stored separately, applied once, and combined isolated totals are explicitly not modifiers. Leech chance XML is percentage. Vibrancy numbers match but its deflection description differs from selected recovery sequence and the loader ignores the effect.
